tool.name: LEMUR
tool.command: Rscript '$__tool_directory__/lemur.R' --input_rds '$sce' --meta_table '$meta_table' --cell_id_column '$cell_id_column' --condition_column '$condition_column' #if str($covariate_columns) != 'None': --batch_column '$covariate_columns' #end if --contrast_condition '$contrast_condition' --reference_condition '$reference_condition' --n_embedding '$n_embedding' --test_fraction '$test_fraction' --linear_coefficient_estimator '$linear_coefficient_estimator' --use_assay '$use_assay' --consider '$consider' --output_umap 'umap_out' --output_volcano 'volcano_out' --output_de 'de_results.tsv' #if str($sel_gene): --sel_gene '$sel_gene' --output_gene_umap 'gene_umap_out' --output_gene_hist 'gene_hist_out' #end if --use_harmony '$use_harmony' --plot_format '$plot_format' --plot_width '$plot_width' --plot_height '$plot_height' --run_tumor_analysis '$tumor_analysis_cond.run_tumor_analysis' #if str($tumor_analysis_cond.run_tumor_analysis) == 'yes': --output_chr_scatter 'chr_scatter_out' --output_tumor_umap 'tumor_umap_out' --output_tumor_neigh 'tumor_neigh.tsv' --tumor_annotation_column '$tumor_analysis_cond.tumor_annotation_column' --chrom1_name '$tumor_analysis_cond.chrom1_name' --chrom2_name '$tumor_analysis_cond.chrom2_name' --chrom1_thresh '$tumor_analysis_cond.chrom1_thresh' --chrom2_thresh '$tumor_analysis_cond.chrom2_thresh' #end if

param.name: meta_table
param.label: Sample metadata table (TSV)
param.help: Tabular file with one row per sample/cell. Must contain columns for condition and optionally for batch or covariates.

param.name: cell_id_column
param.label: Cell ID column
param.help: Column in metadata that contains the cell IDs matching colnames of SCE

param.name: condition_column
param.label: Condition column
param.help: Select the condition column (e.g., treatment vs control). Only appears after loading metadata.

param.name: covariate_columns
param.label: Covariate columns
param.help: One or more covariate variables to include in the design formula, in addition to the condition (e.g. batch, patient, sex, age). At least one is required: find_de_neighborhoods forms pseudobulk samples by grouping on the covariate(s) together with the condition, and a condition-only design cannot be fit (as many coefficients as pseudobulk samples).

param.name: test_fraction
param.label: The fraction of cells that are split off before the model fit to keep an independent set of test observations

param.name: linear_coefficient_estimator
param.label: Linear coefficient estimator
param.help: Estimator used to center the conditions in the linear model fit.

param.name: use_assay
param.label: Assay to use for model fitting
param.help: Name of the SCE assay used for LEMUR model fitting. This only changes the assay used for model fitting; find_de_neighborhoods always reads the 'counts' assay for the pseudobulk differential expression test, so a counts assay is still required in the SCE object.

param.name: consider
param.label: Model parts considered for the DE test
param.help: Which part of the model is considered for the differential expression test.

param.name: use_harmony
param.label: Apply Harmony alignment?
param.help: Enforces additional alignment of cell clusters beyond the direct differential embedding.

param.name: sel_gene
param.label: Gene ID for gene-specific plots (optional)
param.help: Must match a gene ID in the rownames of the SCE object.

param.name: run_tumor_analysis
param.label: Run tumor-specific classification (chromosome-based)
param.help: Optional: classifies cells as tumor/non-tumor based on chromosome gain/loss (as in the glioblastoma example). Not applicable to all datasets — enable only if relevant to your data.

param.name: tumor_annotation_column
param.label: Gene annotation column (in rowData)
param.help: Name of the gene-level (rowData) annotation column that assigns each gene to a chromosome, used to compute per-chromosome expression for tumor classification. Default is 'chromosome'. Override if your SCE uses a different rowData column name.

param.name: chrom1_thresh
param.label: Minimum expression threshold for the gained chromosome
param.help: Minimum mean expression of the gained chromosome (above) required to classify a cell as tumor.

param.name: chrom2_thresh
param.label: Maximum expression threshold for the lost chromosome
param.help: Maximum mean expression of the lost chromosome (above) required to classify a cell as tumor.

tool.help:
LEMUR identifies transcriptional differences across conditions in latent space using single-cell RNA-seq data. This tool wraps the core LEMUR workflow (latent embedding multivariate regression) and can be applied to single-cell data from any tissue or cell type — it is not limited to any specific disease or dataset.
**Inputs:** - A `SingleCellExperiment` object in RDS format. - A metadata table, together with column selectors for the condition and one or more covariate columns (e.g. batch, patient, sex, age); these define the design used for the model fit. At least one covariate is required, because the differential expression step (`find_de_neighborhoods`) groups cells into pseudobulk samples by covariate(s) plus condition and cannot fit the model on a condition-only design. - Parameters for dimensionality and model training. - Optionally, a gene ID for extra gene-specific plots. - Apply Harmony alignment: If selected, the latent space is aligned using Harmony before differential expression analysis. - Selectable output format for all plots: PDF, PNG, or JPG.
**Why use `SingleCellExperiment` (SCE)?** LEMUR uses the `SingleCellExperiment` (SCE) format because it is the standard Bioconductor structure for single-cell data in R. Unlike Seurat or AnnData, SCE is lightweight, interoperable, and not tied to a specific framework. It cleanly separates assays (e.g., expression values), cell metadata (`colData`), feature metadata (`rowData`), and reduced dimensions (`reducedDims`).
For LEMUR to work correctly, the SCE object **must include**: - **`counts()`**: matrix of raw (non-normalized) integer counts, required for the pseudobulk differential expression testing performed by `find_de_neighborhoods()`. - **`logcounts()`**: matrix of log-normalized gene expression, used for model fitting and visualization. - **`colData`**: must contain the variables referenced in the `design` formula (e.g., `patient_id`, `condition`).
You can easily convert Seurat objects using `as.SingleCellExperiment()` in R. Within Galaxy, you can convert between single-cell formats (e.g. Seurat or AnnData) and `SingleCellExperiment` using the **sceasy** and **anndata2ri** tools.
**Outputs:** - UMAP plot - Volcano plot - Table of differentially expressed neighborhoods. Note: `find_de_neighborhoods()` returns each neighborhood's member cell IDs as a nested list-column, which cannot be represented in a flat TSV, so that column is dropped from the exported table. - Gene UMAP + histogram plots if a gene ID is given
**Optional tumor-specific classification:** Enabling "Run tumor-specific classification" performs a chromosome gain/loss-based tumor/non-tumor cell classification, using two configurable chromosome-arm markers (default: chromosome 7 gain / chromosome 10 loss, as used in the glioblastoma example below). This approach can be applied to other tumor types with known chromosome-level copy number alterations by adjusting the chromosome names and thresholds to match your data — it is disabled by default since it's only relevant if your dataset includes this kind of copy-number-based tumor signal. When enabled, it adds three outputs: a chromosome expression scatter plot, a tumor/non-tumor UMAP plot, and a table of differentially expressed neighborhoods restricted to the classified tumor cells.
**More information:** For details on the LEMUR method, see the official LEMUR repository: https://github.com/const-ae/lemur
